Figure 1: On the input side, GOT supports various optical image types, such as commonly used
photographs and documents. Besides, as a general OCR-2.0 model, GOT can handle more tasks, e.g.,
sheet music, molecular formulas, easy geometric shapes, charts, etc. Moreover, the model can adapt
to region-focus OCR, high-resolution OCR, and multiple-page OCR. GOT mainly supports English
and Chinese and can control the structure results (Mathpix markdown/tikz/smiles/kern) via a prompt.
